data.long_meaning: Awadhesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ava-dhEShah', which means 'lord of the gods'. In Hindu mythology, Awadhesh is an alternate name for Lord Vishnu, who is one of the principal deities in Hinduism and is often referred to as the preserver of the universe. The name Awadhesh carries the meaning “Lord of the gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Awadhesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
